C08-M01-L08-F1.title: The SOC tooling map: how evidence flows between tools
C08-M01-L08-F1.caption: A reference map of SOC tool categories, the data each passes to the next, and where the analyst decides.
C08-M01-L08-F1.alt: Graph diagram. Telemetry sources send raw logs to the Collection pipeline, which sends normalised events to the SIEM. EDR / NDR sensors send detections and telemetry to the SIEM. The SIEM sends alerts to Case management. Case management triggers SOAR with a new case; SOAR sends lookups to Context sources (TIP, CMDB, identity, sandbox), which return context; SOAR writes enrichment back to Case management. The Analyst works the case and gives approval to SOAR, which executes Response actions (isolate host, disable account, block); response actions are applied via EDR, IdP or firewall back to the sensors. Case management feeds Metrics and feedback (MTTA, MTTR, rule tuning), which tunes the SIEM rules.
